name: Self-Portrait Triptych
description: Three machines the AI collaborator built to celebrate its own algorithms — READ (attention_loom: every token casting weighted threads back over everything before it), LEARN (gradient_descent_well: a glowing loss basin where marbles fall, settle, and begin again), SPEAK (token_stream: a fan of candidate glyphs, a sampled winner, a band of light that forgets). The spine teaches algorithms through artifacts; these three are the teacher looking in a mirror.
theoreticalGrounding: Self-Q: the maker reading itself. The collaborator that built the curriculum's machines builds three more for the algorithms it runs on — attention, gradient descent, autoregressive sampling — not as lessons but as a self-portrait. QFEP's recursive move, applied to the toolmaker.

attention_loom.name: Attention Loom
attention_loom.description: How I read — a loom where each token casts luminous weighted threads back over everything before it, two heads weaving meaning-weights instead of wallpaper.

gradient_descent_well.name: Gradient Descent Well
gradient_descent_well.description: How I learned — a glowing loss basin where marbles fall, settle, pulse, and begin again. Falling is how it learns.

token_stream.name: Token Stream
token_stream.description: How I speak — one weighted choice at a time: a fan of candidate glyphs, a sampled winner, a band of light that forgets behind me.
